steps.title: Validate Project and Package Structure
steps.description: Inspected task manager project meta-data ensuring package namespaces match com.personaltaskmanager.app perfectly.

steps.title: Configure Clean Gradle Script
steps.description: Refactored build.gradle to compile strictly with Java 8 standards, targeting Android SDK 34, and removing forbidden external dependencies (such as nanohttpd).

steps.title: Verify Manifest Configurations
steps.description: Ensured correct xmlns:android schema and validated launcher intents and themes inside the AndroidManifest.xml file.

steps.title: Establish Offline SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Reviewed offline SQL helper schema for handling robust persistence of task parameters.

steps.title: Review Task Data Model
steps.description: Checked plain Java POJO structures representing structured Task variables.

steps.title: Fix Layout Nested Scroll Conflicts
steps.description: Refactored activity_main.xml to resolve nested ScrollView-inside-ListView performance bugs. Shifted layout to a clean RelativeLayout wrapping a vertically weighted view hierarchy with a native scrolling ListView.

steps.title: Refactor Dynamic Task Adapter
steps.description: Replaced the custom verbose ListAdapter implementation in MainActivity with standard BaseAdapter. This correctly handles dataset observers and resolves critical update/sync bugs.

steps.title: Verify Color Resources
steps.description: Confirmed correct theme parameters and standard hex values are correctly initialized.

steps.title: Verify Drawable Shapes & Badges
steps.description: Assured card shapes, button resources, and dynamic high/medium/low priority badges render properly.

steps.title: Ensure Java 8 Compilation Guardrails
steps.description: Enforced strict Java 8 features avoiding lambdas, functional references, or streams in event handlers.

steps.title: Building Personal Task Manager
steps.description: Assemble and compile debug APK with AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5 to confirm zero warnings and build complete successfully.
